mechanism_narrative: A monotonic four-week rise in WORKPLACES mobility (from -41.1 to -30.6) indicates commuters are returning to offices and commercial districts; the resulting weekday footfall mechanically lifts RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose 10.5 points across t-3w to t-0w while RETAIL_REC rose 1.7 points
regime_hint: steady reopening with no new containment measures
failure_condition: The 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC after the decision point is not higher than the prior 28-day mean whenever WORKPLACES improves in at least three of the four preceding weekly readings.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is climbing toward the -70 percent-of-baseline line at roughly 1.2 points per week; once the weekly mean crosses above -70, discretionary trip-making becomes self-sustaining and RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -70 percent of baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved -75.0 to -71.4 over four weeks, a 3.6 point climb
failure_condition: TRANSIT records a weekly mean above -70 and the subsequent 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the 28-day mean ending at the crossing week.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of falling RESIDENTIAL time (19.6 to 16.4) and rising TRANSIT time (-75.0 to -71.4) marks households abandoning home confinement; the paired signal, not either series alone, drives discretionary retail visits upward over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls at the same time TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 3.2 points while TRANSIT gained 3.6 points over the same window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the following 28 days in weeks where RESIDENTIAL declines and TRANSIT rises simultaneously in both of the prior two weekly pairs.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM hovering within roughly one point of baseline (-1.9 to -0.3) shows essential-errand demand is fully normalized and no new supply-side restrictions are binding; stable essential activity is a precondition for continued recovery of RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains within +/-3 points of baseline for four consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed between -1.9 and -0.3 across all four snapshot weeks
regime_hint: no new containment policy and no essential-goods supply shock
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays inside the +/-3 band for four weeks and the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is below the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has rolled over from -13.6 to -17.0 as autumn weather curtails outdoor leisure; the reallocation of discretionary time from outdoor venues to indoor commercial venues raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS declines by more than 3 points from its four-week peak
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -13.6 at t-2w to -17.0 at t-0w, a 3.4 point drop from peak
regime_hint: cool-season transition with no outdoor capacity limits
failure_condition: PARKS drops more than 3 points from its four-week peak and the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains 16.4 points above baseline, so remote work and home-centered consumption persist; as long as RESIDENTIAL stays above +15 while WORKPLACES stays below -25, office-district retail demand is structurally suppressed and RETAIL_REC declines over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean remains above +15 percent of baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is +16.4 and WORKPLACES is -30.6 at t-0w
regime_hint: entrenched work-from-home regime with no return-to-office mandate
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above +15 for the full four-week horizon and the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden week-on-week jump in GROCERY_PHARM above the flat baseline pattern signals renewed precautionary stockpiling in response to announced restrictions; households withdraw from discretionary venues and RETAIL_REC falls within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises more than 5 points week-on-week above its four-week mean
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM has been flat between -1.9 and -0.3, so a 5 point jump would be a clear regime break
regime_hint: restriction-announcement regime with elevated precautionary behavior
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM jumps more than 5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is equal to or above its level in the week of the jump.
